title: Explain or degrade oversized context-only control deliveries
outcome: A context-only delivery that exceeds the host wire budget produces a cause-specific, recoverable response with actionable omission evidence instead of a bare host-directed DeliveryInvalid wedge.
acceptance: A context-only delivery that exceeds MAX_CONTROL_DELIVERY_BYTES exposes a cause-specific recovery path or safely degrades with an omission manifest.
Regression coverage distinguishes wire-budget overflow from malformed delivery-page refusal and proves the session can recover.
disposal_reason: Superseded by the in-scope correction implemented and tested under w-e89694041785 after round4 review reclassification.
